pr.title: Separate BRC progress tracking from liveness in stall detection
pr.description:
Fixes #1613. The overseer stall detection conflated container liveness (heartbeats) with BRC
protocol progress (state transitions), causing false positives (killing active reviewers pre-BRC)
and false negatives (ignoring producers stuck in heartbeat loops post-ACK). This PR separates
the two signals by adding a post-propose grace period for reviewers and a post-ACK confirmation
timeout for producers in the Tier 1 health monitor.
pr.test_plan:
- Automated: new tests in test_health_monitor.py cover post-propose grace and post-ACK timeout
- Automated: existing test_health_monitor.py tests still pass (no regressions)
- Manual: run a pipeline with concurrent agents and verify reviewer is not killed during pre-BRC analysis
